title: Fortnite Creative tips for aimbot and ESP practice
desc: Creative and bot-lobby workflows to tune aimbot, ESP wallhack and chest ESP before Ranked.

body.text: Creative and bot lobbies are creative tools—not the same as private fortnite cheats used in Ranked. Use them to tune [Pro aimbot](/products/fortnite-cheats/) and ESP ranges before going live on Epic.

items: Load the Ranked preset with high smoothness and moderate FOV.
Run staff mid-range skill chains for five minutes without changing sliders.
Switch to bow close-range tracking, then gun finisher timing.
Only lower smoothness after tracking looks human in replays.
Save a Creative practice profile separate from your Ranked preset.
Start player boxes and skeletons at 1200 units max distance.
Enable health bars and distance readouts; turn off portrait spam.
Add drop and chest ESP only after boxes feel natural.
Pair with [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/fortnite-esp-wallhack-setup/) for Ranked translation.
Test stream-proof mode with a 30-second OBS recording.
Keep mini-radar on for third-part calls.
Practice rotating on zone with radar dots, not tunnel vision.
Disable cluttered loot timers until zone clears feel clean.
Supports use radar to call rotates; fraggers use it to avoid stacked fights.
See [radar hack guide](/blog/fortnite-radar-hack-guide/) for FOV caps.
Fill a bot lobby for semi-realistic team fights.
Practice one class profile at a time—staff, then bow, then gun.
Kick extra bots so only the targets you need remain.
Private Creative instances are the safest place to test [Weapon aimbot guide](/blog/fortnite-aimbot-combat-guide/) before Ranked.
Never first-session a new preset in Ranked on patch day.

body.text: Creative drills stop at the lobby boundary. Ranked on Epic needs external tools with EAC-aware updates. Explore [Lite](/products/fortnite-cheats/), [Pro](/products/fortnite-cheats/), and [Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) at fnhacks.org.
